# Cambridge Dictionary

> > Comprehensive online bilingual dictionary providing English-French translations with examples from Cambridge English Corpus, Hansard, and Europarl.

Cambridge Dictionary is published by Cambridge University Press and offers authoritative translations drawing from multiple sources including the GLOBAL English-French Dictionary, PASSWORD English-French Dictionary (K Dictionaries Ltd), and parliamentary records under the Open Parliament Licence v3.0. The dictionary covers vocabulary ranging from common words to formal terms, idioms, and specialized terminology.

## Key Topics

- English-French translation
- Bilingual dictionary
- Cambridge English Corpus
- Vocabulary reference
- Language learning

- Formal vocabulary

## Common Vocabulary Translations

- [ADVISE | translate English to French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/advise): English-French translation for verb 'advise' with multiple meanings
- [ACCIDENT in French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/accident): English-French translation for 'accident' from GLOBAL & PASSWORD dicts
- [ABROAD | translate English to French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/abroad): English-French translation for 'abroad' with corpus examples
- [ACTIVIST in French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/activist): English-French translation for 'activist' with bilingual examples
- [AFFECTED in French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/affected): English-French translation for adjective 'affected'

## Idiomatic Expressions

- [A COLD SWEAT in French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/a-cold-sweat): English-French translation for idiom 'a cold sweat' (sueur froide)
- [A STONE'S THROW in French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/a-stone-s-throw): English-French translation for distance idiom 'a stone's throw'
- [ABOVE BOARD in French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/above-board): English-French translation for idiom 'above board' (franc, honnête)
- [ADD INSULT TO INJURY in French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/add-insult-to-injury): English-French translation for idiom 'add insult to injury'

## Formal and Specialized Terms

- [ACCEDE | translate English to French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/accede): English-French translation for formal verb 'accede' with phrasal forms
- [ADROIT | translate English to French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/adroit): English-French translation for 'adroit' with Hansard & Corpus examples
- [ABET | translate English to French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/abet): English-French translation for legal term 'abet' with corpus examples
- [ABRASION in French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/abrasion): English-French translation for medical term 'abrasion'
- [ACRE | translate English to French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/acre): English-French translation for land measurement unit 'acre'
- [A-road | translate English to French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/a-road): English-French translation for British road term 'A-road'

- [ABOMINABLY in French - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/abominably): English-French translation for adverb 'abominably'
